meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'come on', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

related.gloss: to give (the verb it comes from)

examples.text: Хоть продавай теперь наш ресторан.
examples.trans: I might as well sell our restaurant now.

examples.text: Давайте, ребята, сейчас не расслабляемся.
examples.trans: Come on, guys, let us not relax right now.

examples.text: Давай, быстро иди за работу.
examples.trans: Come on, go back to work quickly.

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'run', paired with 'побежать'.

examples.text: Беги, Марина, пока не поздно!
examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!

examples.text: Куда ты так быстро бежишь?
examples.trans: Where are you running so fast?

examples.text: Надо бежать! Беги в деревню к маме.
examples.trans: You need to run! Run to the village to your mum's.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'сюда').

examples.text: Потому что нас всех отсюда выгонят.
examples.trans: Because they will kick all of us out of here.

examples.text: Давай беги отсюда, пока шеф не увидел.
examples.trans: Come on, run from here before Chef sees.

examples.text: Я выйду отсюда.
examples.trans: I'll get out of here.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'for now', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Тебе понравится моё новое предложение о покупке.
examples.trans: You will like my new purchase offer.

examples.text: Стой спокойно и красиво улыбайся.
examples.trans: Stand calmly and smile nicely.

examples.text: Давай беги отсюда, пока шеф не увидел.
examples.trans: Come on, run from here before Chef sees.

meanings.en: to see, to catch sight of
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'видеть'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'saw', paired with 'видеть'.

examples.text: Давай беги отсюда, пока шеф не увидел.
examples.trans: Come on, run from here before Chef sees.

examples.text: Беги, пока шеф не увидел!
examples.trans: Run before the chef sees!

examples.text: Вот увидишь!
examples.trans: You'll see!
